name: zsnd_play_handle_set_enable_scale
description: zSndPlayHandle::SetEnableScale applies global sound volume scaling to a backend play handle and refreshes its 3D/backend state.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a zSound backend/provider source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a11d0 validates backend-handle gating, multiplying the supplied scale by g_zSnd_GlobalVolumeScalePtr, storing DirectSound gain through zSnd::GainScaleToDirectSoundAttenuation, storing A3D gain as float bits, and calling zSndPlayHandle::Update3DDispatch with null position and velocity.
The native smoke verifies DirectSound attenuation plus Update3D volume dispatch and A3D float gain storage plus SetGain/SetDopplerScale dispatch.
